description: Move all framework/ content into the appropriate skill references/ folders and update all references across SKILL.md files, steering files, hooks, and README.md to point to the new locations.
steps: Create references/ directories for each skill that needs them: .kiro/skills/start-engagement/references/, .kiro/skills/data-collection/references/, .kiro/skills/feasibility-analysis/references/, .kiro/skills/detailed-assessment/references/, .kiro/skills/generate-plans/references/

Update .kiro/skills/start-engagement/SKILL.md: Change 'framework/engagement-template.md' to 'references/engagement-template.md'. Remove Step 4 entirely (copying phase READMEs - those no longer exist). Change 'framework/100-Data-Collection/100-App-Inventory.xlsx' to reference the data-collection skill's location: '.kiro/skills/data-collection/references/100-App-Inventory.xlsx'.
Update .kiro/skills/data-collection/SKILL.md: Change all 'framework/100-Data-Collection/100-App-Inventory.xlsx' references to 'references/100-App-Inventory.xlsx' (relative to the skill).

Update .kiro/skills/feasibility-analysis/SKILL.md: Change 'framework/200-Mod-Feasibility/feasibility-analysis.md' to 'references/feasibility-analysis.md'. Change 'framework/200-Mod-Feasibility/210-Tool-Feasibility/aws-tools-analysis.md' to 'references/aws-tools-analysis.md'. Change 'framework/200-Mod-Feasibility/assets/atxconfig-coda.yaml' to 'references/atxconfig-coda.yaml'.

Update .kiro/skills/detailed-assessment/SKILL.md: Change 'framework/300-Detailed-Assessment/300-App-Questionnaire.md' to 'references/300-App-Questionnaire.md'. Change 'framework/300-Detailed-Assessment/300-Architecture.md' to 'references/300-Architecture.md'. Change 'framework/300-Detailed-Assessment/detailed-analysis.md' to 'references/detailed-analysis.md'. Change 'framework/200-Mod-Feasibility/assets/atxconfig-coda.yaml' to '.kiro/skills/feasibility-analysis/references/atxconfig-coda.yaml'.

Update .kiro/skills/generate-plans/SKILL.md: Change 'framework/400-Mod-Plan/420-PoC/PoC-Plan-Template.md' to 'references/PoC-Plan-Template.md'. Change 'framework/400-Mod-Plan/420-PoC/sample-output/ADC-PoC-gMSA-Auth.md' to 'references/sample-output/ADC-PoC-gMSA-Auth.md'. Change 'framework/400-Mod-Plan/430-EBA/EBA-Plan-Template.md' to 'references/EBA-Plan-Template.md'. Change 'framework/400-Mod-Plan/430-EBA/EBA-Preparation-Checklist.md' to 'references/EBA-Preparation-Checklist.md'. Change 'framework/400-Mod-Plan/430-EBA/sample-output/ADC-Supplier-Portal-EBA-Plan.md' to 'references/sample-output/ADC-Supplier-Portal-EBA-Plan.md'. Change 'framework/300-Detailed-Assessment/detailed-analysis.md' to '.kiro/skills/detailed-assessment/references/detailed-analysis.md'.

Update .kiro/steering/framework.md: Rewrite to remove all references to the framework/ directory. The new structure is: skills contain their own references in .kiro/skills/{name}/references/. The workspace structure section should show .kiro/skills/ and working/ as the two main areas. Remove the Framework Phases table that links to framework/ READMEs. Replace with a skills-based overview.

Update .kiro/steering/workspace-rules.md: Remove the 'Framework protection' section (framework/ no longer exists). Replace with a 'Skill references protection' rule: files under .kiro/skills/*/references/ are read-only reference material. Add that skills reference their own templates via references/ paths.

Update .kiro/steering/methodology.md: Change fileMatchPattern from '{framework/300-Detailed-Assessment/**,framework/400-Mod-Plan/**,working/**}' to '{.kiro/skills/detailed-assessment/references/**,.kiro/skills/generate-plans/references/**,working/**}'. Update any references to framework/ paths inside the content (e.g., 'framework/200-Mod-Feasibility/assets/atxconfig-coda.yaml' becomes '.kiro/skills/feasibility-analysis/references/atxconfig-coda.yaml').

Update .kiro/hooks/sync-questionnaires.kiro.hook: Change the pattern from 'framework/300-Detailed-Assessment/300-App-Questionnaire.md' to '.kiro/skills/detailed-assessment/references/300-App-Questionnaire.md'. Update the prompt to reference the new path.

Update .kiro/hooks/sync-questionnaire-docs.kiro.hook: Change the pattern from 'framework/300-Detailed-Assessment/300-App-Questionnaire.md' to '.kiro/skills/detailed-assessment/references/300-App-Questionnaire.md'. Update the prompt to reference the new paths (questionnaire and detailed-analysis.md).

Delete .kiro/hooks/sync-100-to-200.kiro.hook: This hook watched '100-Data-Collection/*' which was a framework/ subfolder. The inventory template now lives inside .kiro/skills/data-collection/references/ and the data flow between Phase 100 and 200 is managed by the skills themselves. This hook is obsolete.
The .kiro/hooks/sync-architecture-to-plan.kiro.hook is fine as-is (it watches working/**/*-Architecture.md which stays the same).

Rewrite the root README.md: Remove the 'Framework docs' column in the phase table (no more framework/ READMEs). Remove the 'Workspace Structure' section showing framework/ tree. Replace with a lean overview of skills-based workflow. Keep the Mermaid diagram, skills table, target state, and key tools sections.

Update framework/engagement-template.md content BEFORE copying: Remove the 'Phase Instructions (Reference)' section at the bottom that links to framework READMEs (those will not exist). The template should just have the progress table and How to Use section referencing skills.
Delete the entire framework/ directory using git rm -r framework/
Stage and commit all changes with message: 'refactor: move framework/ content into skill references/ folders'
acceptance_criteria: All reference files exist in .kiro/skills/*/references/ in their correct locations
All SKILL.md files use references/ or .kiro/skills/*/references/ paths
Steering files have updated fileMatchPatterns that no longer reference framework/
Hooks reference .kiro/skills/ paths instead of framework/ paths
Root README.md no longer references framework/ paths
The engagement-template.md in start-engagement/references/ no longer links to framework READMEs
All changes are committed on the feat/modular-kiro-skills branch
verification: Run: test ! -d framework/ && echo PASS || echo FAIL
Run: find .kiro/skills/*/references -type f | wc -l (should be >= 18 files)
Run: grep -r 'framework/' .kiro/ README.md 2>/dev/null | grep -v '.agents/' | wc -l (should be 0)
Run: git status (should show clean working tree after commit)
Run: git log --oneline -1 (should show the refactor commit)
findings: All 18 framework files moved to skill references/ folders. Engagement template had Phase Instructions section removed. Phase READMEs and .gitkeep were not carried forward. sync-100-to-200 hook deleted. Reference files within references/ also had their internal framework/ paths updated (feasibility-analysis.md and aws-tools-analysis.md contained references to the atxconfig-coda.yaml path). Post-review fix: EBA-Plan-Template.md line 13 stale link corrected to ../../detailed-assessment/references/detailed-analysis.md. Four redundant working/sample/*/README.md files deleted (contained 22 dead framework/ links, skills are now authoritative docs).
